'''Interviews''' collected on this wiki are published player (and staff) interviews from SWCCG fan sites and magazines. The first block is the sixteen [[Trandosite]] interviews from 2000. Full text is on each player page under '''Interviews'''; this page is the index.

== DecipherCon 2000 Championship Match Interview ==

Post-match video of [[Matt Sokol]] and [[Yannick Lapointe]] after the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]] Final Confrontation. Derek Brooks provided the footage; brandon baity (NanashiStudios) posted it on 21 August 2018.

* [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ECUW3AIAH3A YouTube]
* Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-ECUW3AIAH3A Internet Archive]
* Player pages: [[Matt Sokol#Interviews]] · [[Yannick Lapointe#Interviews]]
* Convention: [[DecipherCon 2000#Championship Match Interview]]
